item.title: Designing an autonomous framework to detect and classify the fabric defects using wavelet transform and neural network
item.description: A framework that uses the wavelet transform to expose texture defects in fabric images and a neural network to classify them, for quality control.

item.title: An elitist particle swarm optimization with mutation operator and adaptive inertia weight for global optimization
item.description: A particle swarm optimizer that keeps an elite, adds a mutation operator to escape local minima, and adapts its inertia weight during the search.
item.author: jesunahmadushno@gmail.com (Jesun Ahmad Ushno)
